text_block_list.text:
This is an announcement from the Dorowa
executive committee!
We're posting the schedule for the special
lessons on the bulletin boards,
so if you're interested, check it out!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank goodness!
This is my first time joining Dorowa,
y'know. Hey, Chiyo-chan,
you gonna take the lessons too?
text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Friend A

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, I'm…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Surely you're fine without 'em!
I was secretly watching your private lesson
with Ardan-senpai earlier!
♪ You two are lookin' super great!
text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Friend B

text_block_list.text: O-Oh, thanks. But…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
I'm only good at dancing "ordinarily".
I'll never be able to surpass McQueen and
the others like this.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
My style of dance focuses on the basics.
But their dance has choreography I've never
even seen before.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
From their steps, to their fingertips,
even their expressions… the passion in their
dance was overflowing,
enough that I had my breath taken away.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
I'm just "ordinary",
so what do I have that I can win with?
If I want to win…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
I have to become "special" enough to not
lose to anyone.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(I can't just stay as I am.
Compared to McQueen and Teio,
I'm sorely lacking in any kind of appeal.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(If I could dance like Maruzen-san did… I'd
be a little closer to being "special"…!)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Got it, got it. Seeya,
Turbo… hm? You're heading home late too,
Chiyono O-san?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was just in the studio. Y'know,
practicing by myself.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Wow… don't push yourself too hard,
though.
Don't you think you'll worry Ardan-san like
that?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry,
I've been making sure she won't find out.
Because…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
It's one of those things that'll work itself
out if I just keep on trying! Anyway,
good night!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: …Wonder if she's gonna be okay.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Hah… hah…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna win against those two,
I have to be even more like Maruzen-san…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san! You're attending this year's Dorowa,
yes? I heard you've been working hard with
your date for the couple dance.
text_block_list.name: Ardan's Classmate

text_block_list.text:
I'm a big fan of your dancing!
I'm absolutely positive you could win Best
Date no matter who you're paired with!
text_block_list.name: Ardan's Classmate

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I, too,
believe I can aim for as much.
With Chiyono O-san, of course.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: (It's not just "anyone". It's precisely because it's her.)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
The day of the event is drawing near,
so we should practice dancing in our outfits
to get used to them.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Good idea.
We've got to think about the real thing… Um,
Ardan-san?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Would you mind taking a look at my solo part
first?
I've got a trick up my sleeve to win the
title of Best Date!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Your solo part, you say? Well, I don't mind,
but…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
I think it'll really amaze you,
Ardan-san! With this,
I think I'll really be able to show off the
"special" side of me!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: And at the end, I twirl like… this!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(…I did it! I really,
really did it!
Now I'll be "special" for sure–—)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: …That was…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
What do you think,
Ardan-san?
I've been practicing other dance moves for
my solo part, too!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
…I see.
But don't you think it's about time we
practice the part where we dance together?
We're already in our matching outfits,
after all.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
O-Oh yeah, you're right. Okay,
let's get back to practicing together.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: …Huh?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Um, I feel like the rhythm of our couple
dance is kind of off… like it's gotten slower
since the last time we did it.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
No, nothing has changed.
I'm still going by exactly the same
rhythm.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, I see! Sorry about that. Okay,
let's try one more time.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san,
I think your steps may be a tad… fast.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(Why… is this happening?
I should be dancing just like I was before,
but…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: (We're not in sync at all.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(What do I do here? Um… oh,
that's it! If it were Maruzen-san,
she'd take the lead from Ardan-san after
this…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Allow me to take the lead.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Wha— Ardan-san?! Hold on a second,
I'm supposed to—
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: No. I won't concede.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: But I'm—!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(T-This is all wrong.
I can't dance like Maruzen-san like this.
I'm gonna go back to just being
"ordinary"!)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: …gh!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san?!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Are your legs alright?!
You aren't hurt anywhere, are you?!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
…gh, I'm… o… kay… I-I'm sorry!
I just lost my balance!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
…No, it's I who should apologise.
I'm the one who was taking the lead,
but I made you…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Let's end practice here for today.
Just in case,
please do visit the infirmary… We'll continue
again from tomorrow onwards.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
